title: Calculating the Real Living Wage for London and the rest of the UK 2026
gist: The Resolution Foundation sets the 2026-27 real Living Wage at 14.10 pounds for the UK and 15.45 pounds for London, the first rates calculated under a new blended methodology averaging a Minimum Income Standard calculation and a relative-poverty-threshold calculation.

insights.claim: The UK real Living Wage for 2026-27 is 14.10 pounds per hour.
insights.speaker: Nye Cominetti
insights.so_what: Voluntary pay benchmark for accredited employers; a reference point for low-wage cost pressure in the UK.
insights.quote: The UK Living Wage for 2026-27 is £14.10.

insights.claim: The London Living Wage for 2026-27 is 15.45 pounds per hour.
insights.speaker: Nye Cominetti
insights.so_what: London wage-floor benchmark for employers that voluntarily pay above statutory minimums.
insights.quote: The London Living Wage for 2026-27 is £15.45.

insights.claim: The 2026 real Living Wage rates are the first calculated under a blended methodology that averages a Minimum Income Standard calculation and a relative-poverty-threshold calculation.
insights.speaker: Nye Cominetti
insights.so_what: Methodology change affects comparability with prior years' rates, so year-on-year moves should be read with that caveat.

insights.claim: The real Living Wage is a voluntary hourly rate based on what families need to get by, serving as a benchmark for employers that choose to go beyond government-set minimum wages.
insights.speaker: Nye Cominetti
insights.so_what: Gauges the gap between statutory minimums and a voluntary wage floor tied to living costs.
insights.quote: a voluntary hourly pay rate based on what families need to get by

insights.claim: The rates are calculated by the Resolution Foundation and overseen by the Living Wage Commission on behalf of the Living Wage Foundation.
insights.speaker: Nye Cominetti
insights.so_what: Clarifies governance and credibility of the benchmark.
